page_title: FIO 1-0 CRE | Fiorentina v Cremonese 04/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' A cross from Dodo (Fiorentina) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
90+4' Alberto Grassi (Cremonese) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
90+2' 1 - 0 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Moise Kean (Fiorentina), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 1:0.
90+2' Emil Audero makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the right-hand post by Niccolo Fortini (Fiorentina) after a cross from the side.
90+1' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) and Manor Solomon try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.

90+1' So close! Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Fiorentina) delivers a cross into the box, it almost finds the head of one of his teammates, but one of the defenders is quickest to the ball and coolly deals with the threat.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Faris Moumbagna (Cremonese) trips an opposition player and Federico La Penna signals a foul. Fiorentina earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
88' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom right corner. David de Gea is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
88' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post.
88' A cross into the box from Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) is cleared.
87' The current number of corner kicks is 7:3.
85' Paolo Vanoli prepares a substitution. Rolando Mandragora is replaced by Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Fiorentina).
84' Here comes a substitution. Albert Gudmundsson is given a rest as he is replaced by Moise Kean (Fiorentina).
83' Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards the leftside of the goal, but David de Gea makes a magnificent save!
82' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
80' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
80' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) serves up a nice cross, but Emil Audero punches the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.
80' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

79' Wow, what an escape. Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Fiorentina can continue in their attacking effort.
78' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
76' It's time for a substitution. Niccolo Fortini (Fiorentina) comes on in place of Cher Ndour.
76' Davide Nicola decides to make a substitution. Jamie Vardy will be replaced by Faris Moumbagna (Cremonese).
75' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Federico Bonazzoli walks off the pitch to be replaced by Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese).
75' The manager makes a subsitution with Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) coming on for Martin Payero.

73' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Emil Audero makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
72' A lofted cross from Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
69' 16:3 – the total goal attempt statistics. 5:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
67' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
67' The free kick into the penalty area from Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) is cleared.
66' Paolo Vanoli has decided to substitute Luca Ranieri and he is replaced by Robin Gosens (Fiorentina).
66' Fabiano Parisi will be replaced by Manor Solomon (Fiorentina).
66' Martin Payero (Cremonese) brings an opponent down and Federico La Penna interrupts the game. Fiorentina get a free kick.

63' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
63' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
63' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Corner kick. Fiorentina will have an opportunity.
62' A corner kick by Cremonese is thwarted by the well prepared David de Gea (Fiorentina).

61' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) finds some space inside the box and fires a volley at goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender. Cremonese will take a corner kick.
61' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) attempts to find Federico Bonazzoli with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
59' Substitution. Franco Vazquez (Cremonese) has come on for Jari Vandeputte.
58' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) makes a good run to latch onto the free kick from Nicolo Fagioli, but pushes his close-range header high over the bar.
57' Martin Payero (Cremonese) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Federico La Penna blows for a foul.
53' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
50' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
50' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) whips in a cross from the corner, but Emil Audero is well positioned and punches the ball away.
49' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Fiorentina earn a corner.
49' Dodo (Fiorentina) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
48' That's unlucky! Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Emil Audero pulls off a great save to deny Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.
45+5' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
45+4' Dodo (Fiorentina) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Emil Audero intercepts the ball.
45+4' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
45+3' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
45' Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) is penalised for holding. Federico La Penna signals a set piece.
42' Dodo (Fiorentina) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
42' Martin Payero (Cremonese) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
40' NO PENALTY! Referee Federico La Penna has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Fiorentina players are incensed.
37' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Fiorentina using VAR. Let's see what happens.
36' Federico La Penna blows his whistle after Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. PENALTY! A huge scoring opportunity for Fiorentina.
35' Federico Bonazzoli received a sweet pass from Jamie Vardy (Cremonese), but the advance is stopped.
35' Dodo (Fiorentina) attempts to find Roberto Piccoli, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.

33' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
31' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
31' 8:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The number of shots on goal at present is 3:0.
31' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
31' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Cremonese.
29' It is time for a substitution. Alberto Grassi (Cremonese) is on for Warren Bondo.
28' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul. Cremonese have a free kick.
27' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Emil Audero, who smothers the ball.
26' Dodo (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but Emil Audero comes off his line to gather the ball.
25' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
24' A clumsy foul by Warren Bondo (Cremonese) and Federico La Penna blows his whistle.
21' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
20' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
20' Federico La Penna shows a yellow card to Warren Bondo (Cremonese) for his blatant foul.
19' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) receives the ball in space inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends his first-time shot over the bar.

18' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Emil Audero!
17' The percentage of ball possession is – 65:35.
17' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
16' A pass from Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) is intercepted by Emil Audero and the move breaks down.
14' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

14' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Emil Audero pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Fiorentina.
13' Martin Payero (Cremonese) hammers the ball from far out, but it goes narrowly over the bar.
12' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the bar!
11' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Federico La Penna who sees an offensive foul.
11' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
10' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Cremonese get a corner.
9' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) sends the corner into the box, but Emil Audero intercepts it and averts the threat.

8' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.
7' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) sends a long ball forward to Rolando Mandragora, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
7' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
5' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Emil Audero stops the ball from going inside right post.
5' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
3' Neat link-up play between Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) and Jamie Vardy, but David de Gea reads the game well and the move breaks down.

2' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Federico La Penna with no other option than to blow for a foul.
